ablations.name: NO_COVERAGE_GUARD
ablations.observation: When true rare branches are omitted, homogeneous remaining support falsely authorizes halt; coverage guard rejects.

ablations.name: NO_DECISION_EPOCH_GUARD
ablations.observation: A previously invariant witness can become false after policy/decision mapping changes; epoch guard rejects stale witness.

ablations.name: CONFIDENCE_0_90
ablations.observation: RARE_BRANCH accuracy 0.9375 with zero queries versus IAC 1.0 at 1.875 mean queries.

ablations.name: STATE_CERTAINTY
ablations.observation: COMPRESSED needs 5 queries versus IAC 1 while both are exact.

ablations.name: MYOPIC_VOC
ablations.observation: PARITY_SYNERGY stops at zero queries and 0.5 accuracy because one-step gain is zero; IAC continues to 5 and is exact.

ablations.name: RESOURCE_MATCHED_FIXED
ablations.observation: At the same expected query count, randomized fixed budget achieves 0.9375 on RARE_BRANCH and about 0.854 on DIFFUSE versus IAC 1.0 in this deterministic corpus.

ablations.name: PLAIN_ACTION_SET_CARDINALITY
ablations.observation: Predicate-equivalent to IAC on every reachable prefix in all tested seeds/regimes; kills distinct data-structure/runtime claim.

interpretation: IAC value is a typed safety/currentness/coverage contract around a simple projection predicate, not a novel selection algorithm.
